title: Rewire wdpkr to consume wdpkr-core
description:
In the wdpkr repo: drop the extracted modules, depend on wdpkr-core, and keep only the glue — src/cli/, src/main.rs, and the two store adapters (turbopuffer.rs, nidus.rs) registered against wdpkr-core's StoreProvider. wdpkr keeps its nidus dependency; core must not gain one.

Verify with a [patch.crates-io] entry pointing at the local checkout before wdpkr-core is published. Behavior must not change: the full wdpkr test suite stays green.

title: Extract store/ traits, types, and provider registry
description:
Move VectorStore, StoreProvider, the provider registry, and the document/namespace types (Namespace, VectorDocument, SearchResult, SearchOptions, NamespaceMetadata, UpsertStats) from wdpkr's src/store/mod.rs. Namespace derivation keeps its blake3 hashing.

Leave behind: turbopuffer.rs and nidus.rs. providers() no longer returns a hardcoded vec — backends register from the consuming crate.

This is the foundation; most other extractions depend on it.

title: Make StoreConfig backend-opaque
description:
src/config/store.rs hard-codes TurbopufferConfig { api_key } and NidusConfig { path } (plus StoreSources, default_nidus_path, and the WDPKR_NIDUS_PATH / turbopuffer env keys). Core cannot name a backend, so this needs a design before config or store can move.

Direction: StoreConfig keeps 'provider' plus an opaque per-backend settings bag; each StoreProvider owns its own typed config, env keys, defaults, and validate(). The 4-layer resolution (defaults -> file -> env -> flags) and Source attribution must survive, including 'wdpkr config' output listing backend keys that core has never heard of.

Blocks the config and store extractions. Decide the shape first, in a decision record.

title: Extract wdpkr's core engine into wdpkr-core
description:
Move the walk/chunk/summarize/embed/search engine out of the wdpkr repo into this crate, leaving wdpkr as the glue layer (CLI + the Turbopuffer and nidus store adapters) and letting nidus implement VectorStore against itself.

The invariant: wdpkr-core never depends on a concrete store backend. Storage arrives only through the VectorStore trait. 'just deps-check' gates it.

Target layout here: config, chunk, ai_providers, http, summarize, embed, store (traits only), search, indexer, tap, decision, eval, testing.

title: Publish wdpkr-core 0.1.0
description: Land the release: cargo publish via the release workflow on a version bump, then switch wdpkr and nidus from [patch.crates-io] to the published version. Confirm 'just publish-check' passes first.

title: Extract ai_providers/, embed/, and summarize/
description: Move the provider adapters (voyage, openai, ollama, anthropic), the PROVIDERS capability registry (Embed/Summarize), the Embedder and Summarizer traits, their build_* factories, prompt templates, and big-file rollup. Voyage stays embed-only.

title: Extract config/ 4-layer resolution
description: Move the defaults -> file -> env -> flags resolution, FileConfig, Resolved/Source attribution, default_config.yaml, tap config, and test_helpers. Applies the backend-opaque store config decided in wdpkr-core-6fa.1.

title: Let nidus implement wdpkr-core's VectorStore
description:
In the nidus repo: implement StoreProvider + VectorStore against nidus itself, importing wdpkr-core. Feature-gate it so the pure library build is untouched, and check the dep tree and Miri gates still pass given core's tree-sitter FFI.

Open question to settle here: does the nidus-backed adapter live in nidus (and wdpkr drops its copy) or stay in wdpkr? Decide before duplicating it.

title: Extract testing/ mocks
description: Move MockVectorStore, MockEmbedder, MockSummarizer, MockTap and fixtures. MockVectorStore becomes the only VectorStore implementation in this crate — which is what keeps the test suite backend-free.

title: Extract chunk/ tree-sitter chunking
description:
Move the Chunker trait, languages.rs, and the tree_sitter implementation with all 8 language deps.

Note: this is the crate's only FFI. nidus is deliberately pure-Rust/zero-FFI and will import this crate — if that becomes a problem, the fix is a feature gate here, not a second crate. Flag it if nidus's Miri or dep-tree gates complain.

title: Extract http/ shared retry client
description: Move RetryPolicy + send_with_retry. Used by every AI provider adapter and (in wdpkr) the Turbopuffer store, so it must stay public.

title: Add a just recipe for the PR + merge queue flow
description: The branch -> PR -> queue sequence is documented in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md but typed by hand every time. Wrap it in a recipe so the flow is one command and cannot be misremembered.

title: Extract decision/ records
description: Move the store-native architectural decision records: the <namespace>--decision namespace, governed_by attachment on code results, supersedes/overrides.

title: Extract search/ orchestration and output
description: Move search orchestration and the JSON/pretty output. Note src/search/mod.rs derives clap ValueEnum on public option enums — clap is already a dependency here for derives only, no CLI parsing.

title: Extract indexer/ pipeline
description: Move the git diff -> walk -> chunk -> summarize -> embed -> upsert pipeline, plus cost estimation, docstring/prose handling, and walk. Writes through the VectorStore trait only.

title: Extract tap/ source adapters
description: Move the tap trait plus files, linear, notion, and process adapters. Keeps the linear-mg and serde_yaml deps.

title: Extract eval/ harness
description: Move the retrieval-quality harness: runner, metrics, output.
